carmen: dropped a new direction in Figma for the pipeline form + delete flow. link: https://www.figma.com/file/new-ux carmen: 3 decisions I'd like quick takes on: 1) show inline errors immediately vs after blur, 2) label required fields with '(required)' or keep asterisk only, 3) archive-with-undo vs instant removal for deletes. li: quick thoughts: 1) validate on blur for complex fields (YAML, JSON) but live/keyup for simple constraints (length, allowed chars). avoids noisy messages while typing. li: 2) '(required)' for long, multi-step wizards. asterisk for short forms or when space is tight. be consistent in the system tokens. dev: 3) prefer "Archive" with explicit expiry and recoverability for most user-facing deletes. Instant purge only when the dataset is marked immutable/regulated. show a clear line: Archive -> Permanently delete after X days. sam: accessibility note: when we show the error summary, use role="alert" or aria-live="assertive"? I'm leaning to assertive for summaries that appear on submit so screen readers announce immediately. Inline errors can be polite. sam: also the undo snackbar should be keyboard focusable and have role="status" with visually hidden text stating the time window. marta: microcopy nit: keep inline errors terse: 'Required', 'Use 3\t60 chars', or 'Invalid cron: missing field'. top summary can be slightly more natural language: '2 issues fix the following fields'. carmen: good. on inline vs blur: agree to mix behavior by field type. we'll map field types in the component docs. question on the error-summary trigger: show when >=2 errors or >=3? li: i'd say >=2 for long forms where missing 2 related fields blocks progress; >=3 for shorter forms. maybe a rule: if totalVisibleFields > 6, summary threshold = 2, else 3. record it in the doc. dev: delete escalation idea: if deletion affects scheduled tasks or external integrations, open a modal requiring a checkbox "I understand consequences" plus a short list of affected items. typed-name confirm only for flagged PII or legal-required assets. sam: localization concern: typed-name confirm expecting exact match can be brittle across locales and character sets. prefer checkbox + explicit reason for non-latin scripts. marta: UX for undo timing: test variants: 15s vs 30s vs persistent in Trash UI. default to 30s for quick undo and keep items discoverable in Trash for 30 days. show TTL in snackbar: 'Archived Undo (30s)'. carmen: here's a tiny ARIA snippet we can include in the components doc to handle the summary + focus jump: ```
2 issues found. Name, Schedule
// on anchor click: document.querySelector('#name').focus(); ``` carmen: and for the snackbar: ```
Archived (recoverable 30 days).
``` li: looks good. also add aria-describedby to inputs that have example patterns so screen readers can read constraints before errors occur. dev: engineers: we'll implement a signals-based escalation: if (resource.sensitive || downstreamCount > 0 || selectedCount > 4) => show the modal with checkbox; if (resource.legalHold) => require typed confirm. I'll put the pseudo-rule in the components doc. sam: PR checklist addition request: 'keyboard focus test for error summary links', 'voiceover readout for snackbar', 'localization review for confirm flows'. design-bot: can you add these to the template? design-bot: added: "keyboard focus test for error-summary anchors", "voiceover/snackbar read-through", "i18n review for confirmation patterns" to PR checklist. :white_check_mark: carmen: thanks all. i'll update Figma with the hybrid validation timing, explicit '(required)' default for multi-step forms, and archive-first deletion path with TTL copy. will tag for a quick test next week. :thumbsup:
